items.title: Florian J. "Curly" Lizana Interview, 1966-05-18
items.q: He didn't pick up with his music again until these Willis Fall bands came together.

ctx.x: The Depression was on then, too. That one's a bit tough.

Well, he played the Morrison's during the Depression. Probably had gone back to Morrison's after these other engagements. He didn't pick up with his music again until these Willis Fall bands came together.
We've got a picture from the Hambone Inn. It says, it's you on saxophone, F.J. Curley-Lazana. And there's a clarinet in the picture, too. That's his. And one of the guitar players is named Bobby.
